cipher.idea: A highly intuitive, word-level cipher designed to maximize semantic coherence for the language model. Instead of reversing the entire text character-by-character (which destroys word boundaries and leads to gibberish), this cipher only reverses the order of the words in the sentence. Individual words, their capitalization, and their internal spelling remain completely intact. Punctuation marks are treated as separate words so their positions are also reversed cleanly.

1. Split the input text into a list of tokens (words and punctuation marks) using spaces as boundaries. To ensure perfect reversibility, any punctuation mark (like '.', ',', '!', '?') must be separated from its adjacent word by a single space before reversing.
2. Reverse the order of the list of tokens.
3. Join the reversed tokens back together with a single space.

2. Reverse the order of the list of tokens.
3. Join the tokens back together with a single space to reconstruct the original sentence.
